title: Papa's Snoring Band - Fun Manipuri Kids Song | BuBu TV - Manipuri
description:
Papa falls asleep on the sofa, and his loud snores turn into a funny drum band!
The kids learn that quiet, gentle play helps Papa rest, and then the whole family joins in the fun.
A cheerful song for little ones who love music, rhythm and silly family moments.
